Direct expansion gives Pq=(5/8)q−u/4+v/4 for q=u²+v²−2/3 and exact eigenfunction e=q−10u/11+2v/11 with eigenvalue 5/8. Orthogonality to centered affine coordinates and E[q²]=8/45 give all k≥0 covariances 8(5/8)^k/45. Geometric summation proves variance 104n/135−128(1−(5/8)^n)/81 for all n≥1. Polynomial transfer characteristic polynomial is λ²(λ−1)(λ−5/8)(λ²−3λ/4+1/4), so centered degree≤2 decay is sharply 5/8, affine eigenspace modulus 1/2. The bounded polynomial h=5q/3−4u/3+2v/3 solves (I−P)h=Pq; d=q+h−h∘F has Pd=0 and ∫d²=104/135; using the original Bernoulli ergodicity theorem and standard reverse-martingale CLT, coboundary correction O(1) gives N(0,104/135).
